Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a one-week history of fever.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Hx of fever for a week

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has had fever for a week with sweatiness, body and muscle aches, nausea, fatigue, night sweats and alternating hot and cold episodes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Hx of fever for a week with associated sweatiness, body/muscle aches, nausea, fatigue, night sweats, hot/cold episodes

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports drinking less than normal.
